description: Registry of field-observed keyboard layouts maintained in this repository. Consulted before falling back to the OS-supplied XKB geometries. See README.md to contribute one.

layouts.name: Lenovo Calliope (space-saving full-size)
layouts.notes: Transcribed from the physical keycaps. Differs from pc104: Insert in the function row, ScrLk before PrtSc, Home/End on the number row, double-height Delete, an Fn key that emits nothing, and no right Super.

osGeometries.description: XKB geometry names available from the OS at /usr/share/X11/xkb/geometry. Used as fallbacks when no field-observed layout matches. Presence is checked at runtime, not assumed.
